# Jobs of a build run that may FAIL and still let a PRERELEASE through, by
# name, with a reason and a date (UTC, inclusive). tools/releasegate.py reads
# this; release.yml's `which` job runs it for every release and every
# [publish]. A date in the past counts as no entry. Only `powercut / e2e (...)`
# jobs can be listed: a failing build, unit or gating test always refuses.
# An entry never lets the FULL release out ([latest]): that needs it green.
#
#   job name | expires YYYY-MM-DD | why
#
# 2026-10-23 (E): the only slice of the no-stick power cut that is red, on
# run 39962229132: 3 of 57 checks, all in "a partition that was not AurOS's"
# (a recovery partition resized after the install: Put Windows back does not
# refuse, does not say why, and does not leave the disk untouched). It is
# docs/safety/FINDINGS.md S-01/S-02, A2's. The other three slices (installs
# cut at 13 instants, and the restore cut at 5) are green.
powercut / e2e (powercut-nostick-restore)|2026-10-26|S-01/S-02: Put Windows back must refuse a partition it did not make (3 of 57 checks); A2
